<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <title>MoonPond - Three.js 3D Letters</title>
  <style>
    body { margin: 0; overflow: hidden; background: #1a2e45; }
    canvas { display: block; width: 100vw; height: 100vh; }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <script src="https://unpkg.com/three@0.160.0/build/three.min.js"></script>
  <script>
    const scene = new THREE.Scene();

    // Load extruded text geometry and font
    const loader = new THREE.FontLoader();
    loader.load(
      'https://unpkg.com/three@0.160.0/examples/fonts/helvetiker_regular.typeface.json',
      function (font) {
        const geometry = new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry('moonpond', { font: font, size: 2.5 }, true);
        const material = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xffffff, roughness: 0.3, metalness: 0.1 });

        const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);
        scene.add(mesh);

        // Ambient light for soft fill
        const ambient = new THREE.AmbientLight(0x404040);
        scene.add(ambient);

        // Directional light to highlight the 3D extrusion
        const dirLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 1.5);
        dirLight.position.set(5, 8, 5);
        scene.add(dirLight);

        const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(60, window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight, 0.2, 100);
        camera.position.z = 18;

        // Simple post-process to give depth: a soft radial blur overlay
        function applyPostProcess() {
          mesh.material.envMap = new THREE.BoxHelper(mesh).material;
          mesh.material.envMapIntensity = 1.2;
        }
        applyPostProcess();

        const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true, preserveDrawingBuffer: false });
        renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
        document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

        // Responsive resize handling
        function onResize() {
          camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
          camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
          renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
        }
        window.addEventListener('resize', onResize);

        // Animation loop with a gentle float motion for the text
        function animate() {
          requestAnimationFrame(animate);
          mesh.position.y = Math.sin(Date.now() * 0.0012) * 0.4;
          renderer.render(scene, camera);
        }
        animate();
      }
    );
  </script>
</body>
</html>
